:= by
  have := instFiniteMonoidHomUnitsOfHasEnoughRootsOfUnityExponent M R (CommMonoid.toCommGroup M) (CommRing.toCommMonoid R) (Finite.toFinite M) (HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.toHasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Monoid.exponent Mˣ))
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Nonempty.intro this
  let χ := MulChar.ofMonoidHom M R f
  haveI : Fintype (MulChar M R) := MulChar.fintype M R
  haveI : Fintype (Mˣ) := Fintype.ofFinCard (Nat.card Mˣ)
  have card_mul_char : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card Mˣ :=
    by
      rw [MulChar.card]
      exact Nat.card_congr (MulChar.equiv M R f)
  exact card_mul_char
